title: Mass account password change
description: Prior to deploying Macaw ransomware in an organization, adversaries will change the password for hundreds or thousands of accounts in order to lock users out of the network and impeded recovery efforts.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Microsoft Defender Endpoint Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Command Line' like '*user*' and 'Command Line' like '*/Domain*' and 'Command Line' like '*/Active:Yes*' and 'Command Line' like '*/PasswordChg:No*')) | timestats span = 1day count as commands by Entity | where commands > 200
